loras.name: brdmc
loras.notes: Broderick recurring AUTHOR-AVATAR character-consistency LoRA (heavyset bald man, full gray beard, thick black rectangular glasses), trained on 17 isolated ink avatar crops. VALIDATED 2026-06-14: the bare 'brdmc, <pose>' trigger does NOT bind on Flux (yields inconsistent photoreal people, no ink). It WORKS when the prompt includes the ink style block + the avatar described + brdmc -> renders a CONSISTENT avatar in Broderick B&W ink across poses (see _training/samples/char/). USE: style-block + 'a heavyset bald man with a full gray beard and thick black rectangular glasses' + brdmc; scale ~0.9-1.0. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/broderick/hand/char/broderick_char.safetensors -> aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/.

loras.name: brdrck
loras.notes: Broderick ink/look STYLE LoRA v2 (173 panels, short trigger-only captions). GOAL was to make the bare 'brdrck' trigger fire the style; VALIDATED 2026-06-14 that it did NOT — bare trigger still inert on Flux (generic cartoon), same class of failure as v1. NOT an improvement over v1 for the trigger problem. BUT produces strong Broderick B&W ink when the style is DESCRIBED in the prompt (e.g. 'black and white hand-drawn ink comic, bold confident linework, loose cross-hatching, white background') — see _training/samples/flux_v2/. USE via style-block prepend (projects/broderick/style_kernel.json 'look'), NOT the bare trigger; scale ~0.85-1.0. Flux lesson: a rare trigger token does not bind a style the way SDXL does. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/broderick/hand/flux_v2/broderick_flux_v2.safetensors -> aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/.
